narrative.overview: A product-launch experience in which WNF.AI becomes a tangible collaborator held in human control. One theatrical opening gives way to calm, source-backed chapters.

rules.name: The Orange Is an Object Rule
rules.body: Robot orange belongs to the robot and its direct system pulse.

rules.name: The Scale Carries the Drama Rule
rules.body: Large type, space, and weight create the hierarchy.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Physical Rule
rules.body: A shadow is allowed only when an object feels physically above the page or responds to interaction.

rules.name: Launch-object scale
rules.body: The WNF.AI mark and short full-viewport statements may exceed the ordinary content-heading ceiling while support copy stays on the readable type ramp.

dos: Do preserve the four approved opening beats and measured five-second pacing.
Do use the official logo and exact current homepage copy.
Do keep the human visibly in control.
donts: Don't copy Apple trademarks, product media, copy, pricing, or navigation branding.
Don't invent clients, results, testimonials, guarantees, or metrics.
Don't use gradient text, generic purple-blue gradients, or card-filled agency styling.
